description: A ring of addressable NeoPixel-compatible RGB LEDs (default 16 pixels), with its own regulated power/ground pins.
how_to_use: GND/VCC are power, DIN is the data input from the microcontroller (or from the previous unit's DOUT), and DOUT passes the same data stream on to the next unit in a chain — DIN/DOUT is a plain digital signal (bit-banged by the sketch), not a shared bus, so each link in a chain is its own independent connection.
